**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (stacked on #560 -> #551; merge parents first).

Reviewed only what the PR adds over #560 (`1b5747f6..d8fedc81`, 55 files, +1403/-32). The upstream/main merge `1b5747f6` has an empty remerge-diff, so it is clean. No `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts, `Cargo.*`, process-file, snapshot PNG or CHANGELOG changes.

**What looks good**
- Electrode kind: `Tool::is_sane` makes rpm 0 mandatory for `Torch | Electrode` and `electrode::is_sane` requires a finite positive Y size and a sharp face (`tools.rs`, `electrode.rs`). `torch_refusal` routes the electrode's refusal by name through the existing AddTool / ChangeTool / library seam. Only `SinkerBurn` lists `tk::ELECTRODE`, so no cutting kind mounts one. Holder and spun-body code gets a plain cylinder envelope, and rest masks treat an electrode as removing nothing (`rest/ahead.rs`), which is the safe side.
- `SinkerBurn` is admitted only by `Family::Sinker` on `Kind::SinkerEdm`, and refused by name elsewhere (`gates.rs`). `condition_gap` checks the machine kind first, then does a by-id lookup that asks only for `ConditionField::Gap`. A blank or unknown id is refused by name.
- Datum arithmetic checked (`motion/src/sinker.rs`). Work top: top-depth. Cavity floor: floor+depth (stand-off). Tip: approach-depth. Refused by name: past the floor datum, past the model's lowest facet, deeper than `flute_len`, a non-positive depth, a bad gap or feed, and an approach plane at or below the top. The tip stops at floor+gap, so the cavity reaches the stated floor.
- Box atom (`dexel_box.rs`): the per-axis interval windows are correct, and Z is evaluated at the window ends (exact for a linear chord). Index math uses floor + clamp. It is gated before any column is cut (finite, positive faces, gap >= 0, no posed moves, no arcs), so a refusal never leaves a half-run grid. The face is grown by the gap and the chord is lowered by the gap. The field eye (`stock_view.rs`) refuses an electrode program by name instead of cutting it as a disc.
- `a_burn_deeper_than_the_cavity_is_convicted_by_the_stock_sim` goes through `simulate_document` (the program verdict): 1 mm overburn gives gouge cells and max gouge about 1.0. The matching on-floor burn reads 0 gouge cells.
- Appended-only shared tables (tag 41, Section/Family/ToolKind last, stamp digests the gap). The only golden added is `sinker_burn_cavity.cl`; the kind-count / ribbon / tool_law / tips tests are updated to match the new row. The MCP claim is pinned by `the_sinker_burn_is_driven_over_mcp_with_the_gui_commands`. Provenance lines, decision file, `Changelog:` and `Fixes #541` are present. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in non-test additions.

**Local results** (trial state = PR head, which already contains upstream/main c9156664; sccache, own `target/`)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test sinker_burn` | 7 passed |
| `tool_law` / `tool_gate` / `tool_body` / `_bands` / `_judged` / `_view` | 4 / 9 / 12 / 13 / 8 / 7 passed |
| `edm_machine` / `edm_conditions` | 7 / 6 passed |
| `golden_cl` / `project_roundtrip` / `ribbon` / `mcp` | 25 / 71 / 12 / 13 passed |
| `camcraft-sim --lib` / `camcraft-tools --lib` / `camcraft-motion --lib` | 70 / 57 / 192 passed (1 ignored) |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`, `--test-threads=1`) | 536 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p tools -p sim -p motion -p app -p ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `dexel_box.rs` has no unit tests of its own (cell-edge coverage, a degenerate zero-length chord); it is exercised only through the app tests. A small sim-crate test would pin the cell-edge rule at the unit level.
2. The condition id and gap are resolved at generate / stamp / sim-plan time, not at `CreateOperation`/`EditOperationParams`, so a missing condition is refused by name at `GenerateOperation::new` rather than at creation. This is consistent with the machine being editable after the op exists, but earlier feedback would be nicer.
3. For the `ElectrodeTip` datum the stated depth is the burn floor below the approach plane, so the tip itself travels depth minus gap. The page labels it "down from approach"; worth a hint line saying the gap is subtracted.
4. The new Sinker page has no dedicated structural assertion; coverage is the tips and tab-law tests. The structural twin can be added with #548's full pages. No snapshot PNGs are touched.
5. Files already past ~400 lines (`kinds.rs`, `generate.rs`, `params.rs`, `pages.rs`, `stock_sim.rs`) grew slightly; new files are small.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Needs changes before merge** (delta review of ed6a1eb4..50e395e8; the code reads correct, but the new safety-floor branches have no pinning tests).

**What looks good**
- `Held::simulate_box` (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_held.rs:159`): plain column and carried column both call the same `stock_sim::simulate_box(dex, moves, hx, hy, gap)` the earlier dexel path used, on the grid in the current frame. The carried grid is already in the current frame (the same grid `CarriedStock::simulate` hands to `cut::simulate`), so the box burn needs no extra transform and there is no off-by-a-turn. Both field arms (`Plain(Field)` and `Carried(Field)`) return `ELECTRODE_FIELD_REFUSAL` by name. `stock_sim_carry.rs:230` prefixes the op name and propagates; there is no silent no-op. `stock_view::display_inputs` (stock_view.rs:183) refuses the field view the same way.
- Overburn test `a_burn_deeper_than_the_cavity_is_convicted_by_the_stock_sim` still goes through `simulate_document` (the program verdict) and passes.
- Icon: `assets/ui/svg/op-sinker-burn.svg` is an original 4-line electrode-over-cavity glyph; PNG is 32x32; `cargo xtask icons --check` = 0 breaches; no `crates/ui/tests/snapshots` file changed; `every_op_kind_has_its_own_svg_mastered_icon` passes.
- `op_icon` lives only in `op_icons.rs` (SinkerBurn arm at line 29); panes.rs holds no stale copy.
- `electrode.rs` has `turning: None`. The `coarse_laws.rs` wording fix (+ SinkerBurn in the refused list) is the same line as PR #1176; whichever lands first, the other merges cleanly.
- `Family::admits` has `(Family::Sinker, Kind::SinkerEdm)`; `posting_family::family_at_post` is wired at posting.rs:817 and the create-time gate (gates.rs) refuses a burn on a non-sinker by name.
- No build.rs, `.github/`, scripts, Cargo or process-file change (only `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`, a machine-dir doc, so no PROCESS_VERSION bump needed).

**Local results** (worktree at the PR head; it already contains `upstream/main`, trial merge "Already up to date"; own `target/`, sccache)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| sinker_burn | 7 passed |
| coarse_laws | 6 passed |
| edm_conditions | 1 passed |
| edm_machine | 5 passed |
| camcraft-app --lib | 143 passed |
| camcraft-sim (lib + all test bins, incl. carried_stock, field_carry) | all ok, 73 lib |
| camcraft-ui --lib (CWD crates/ui, --test-threads=1) | 574 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo xtask icons --check` | 0 breaches |
| clippy -D warnings, post/app/sim/motion/ui/tools, all targets | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. No test exercises `Held::simulate_box` on a carried column grid (stock_sim_held.rs:159-167) or its field refusal. `ELECTRODE_FIELD_REFUSAL` and `Held::simulate_box` appear in no test file (grep over `crates/*/tests` and the test modules). Add (a) a field-engine test: a sinker program under the field backend returns an error containing the name of the op and the refusal text from `simulate_document`, and `stock_view::display_inputs` refuses likewise; (b) a carried-column test: a burn in a setup entered through `Entry::Carry` cuts the same cells as the plain grid (e.g. gouge/`max_gouge` equal to the plain overburn case). These are the safety-floor branches the PR added for main's `Held` and today only the plain path is pinned.
2. `posting_family::family_at_post` (posting_family.rs:21) has no test of either side: a Sinker Burn on a sinker machine must post-admit, and a burn (or a milling op) remounted onto the wrong machine must be refused with "cannot run on its setup's ... machine". `edm_machine.rs:70` only covers `post_serves`. Add one test of each.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Op tag 41 may collide with #532's appended kind (already in the PR comment); whichever merges second renumbers.
- `Section::Sinker` reuses `Icon::Drill` and the machine door uses `Icon::Pocket`/`Contour`, as documented in panes.rs.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2c1efae902d843d27f3eeb53aac868e627ab17d5 -->
**Needs changes before merge.**

This is the first independent review of this PR. It covers head `2c1efae9`, which includes `05a44be7`, the merge of upstream main `c6091eca` and the lathe_voice test commit. Only this PR's own changes over #560's head (`a802866a`) were judged. #560's two open requests are not raised again here; how this PR depends on them is covered under Requested, item 3.

### What looks good
- The generator (`crates/motion/src/sinker.rs`) is small and readable. It refuses each case by name before it builds a move: a value that is not finite, a negative depth, a zero depth from any datum except the cavity floor, a negative gap, a feed of zero or less, a floor datum above the top, a burn past the floor datum, a burn past the model's floor, a burn floor that does not enter the work, an approach plane at or below the top, and a burn deeper than the electrode is long. The depth sign is consistent across all three datums.
- The family gate refuses a Sinker Burn on any machine that is not a sinker EDM when the operation is created (`commands/operation/gates.rs`). At post, `posting_family` refuses a milling op remounted onto a sinker. The lathe table (`lathe_voice`, from #1202) gives SinkerBurn the `_ => Refused` arm, which is the right verdict, and `lathe_voice_tests` now counts 29 refused kinds.
- Verify uses a real box atom for the electrode (`sim/stock_sim/dexel_box.rs`): the face grows by the gap on every side and below. In my local probe below, an oversize burn was convicted as a gouge. The field engine and the stock view refuse an electrode by name instead of cutting it as a disc. Rest machining counts the burn as air, which is the safe side.
- The op stamp digests the resolved gap, so changing the condition marks the op Stale. Undo works through the normal commands, and MCP drives it with the existing tools (`add_tool`, `add_operation`, `edit_operation`, `generate`, `undo`).
- Each new module carries a provenance comment, and the new glyph is original SVG. No snapshot PNG changed and no existing golden changed; the only new golden is `sinker_burn_cavity.cl`. No new dependency, no `build.rs`, no `.github` or script changes. No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` outside tests. The casts in `dexel_box.rs` follow the existing atoms, and the grid is guaranteed at least 1 x 1.

### Local results
Run on the PR head. The trial merge with `origin/main` (`62a2c93a`) was a no-op: the head already contains it.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test --no-run` for tools, motion, sim, post, app | built |
| tools lib | 70 passed |
| motion lib | 199 passed, 1 ignored |
| sim lib | 86 passed |
| post lib | 37 passed |
| app lib (includes `lathe_voice_tests`) | 148 passed |
| app: sinker_burn 7, sinker_burn_held 6, coarse_laws 6, tool_law 4, ribbon 12, edm_conditions 1, edm_machine 5, golden_cl 25, project_roundtrip 71, model_fidelity 9, commands_undo 30, mcp 18, operations 117 (6 ignored), stock_sim_document 9, verify 21 (2 ignored), posting 17, tool_library 13, lathe_work_spindle 5, plasma_gate 6, heights 11, setup_sheet 7, stock_view 4 | all passed |
| `cargo clippy` for tools, motion, sim, post, app (`--all-targets -D warnings`) | clean |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | **does not compile** |

```
error[E0004]: non-exhaustive patterns: `ToolKind::Electrode` not covered
   --> crates\ui\src\egui_app\tool_icons.rs:17:11
```

### Requested before merge
1. **camcraft-ui does not build at this head.** Main's #645 added `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_icons.rs`. Its `tool_icon` match lists every tool kind on purpose, and the merge `c6091eca` did not add `ToolKind::Electrode` to it. Fix: add an original electrode tool glyph, an `Icon` variant for it in `icons.rs`, and the match arm. Then make sure the structural test that checks no two kinds share a glyph still passes. Because the app cannot build, the UI side of this PR (op page, browser tree, ribbon) was not exercised.

2. **A Sinker Burn posts milling G-code to the sinker EDM.** The PR body says "Posting: none ... `post_serves` still refuses every EDM". But `post_serves` only decides which posts the picker lists (its own doc comment says "this is the picker's listing law, not a gate"). `default_post_for(SinkerEdm)` returns `PostRef::Builtin`, and nothing in `post_setup` / `post_script_body` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs:426-460`) refuses a program on an EDM. Before this PR no op could reach that path on an EDM, because the family gate refused them all. This PR adds the first op that does. A local probe test (`sinker_doc(6.0)`, `Burn0` 3 mm from the work top, then `posting::post_setup`) wrote this file:

   ```
   %
   O0001 (SINKER EDM 3-AXIS TEMPLATE)
   G21
   (OPERATION: Burn0 - SINKER BURN - G54)
   G90 G54 G40 G49 G80
   (T01 E-10x6 - SINKER ELECTRODE D10)
   T01 M6
   G43 H01
   M5
   G00 X0 Y0 Z25
   G01 X0 Y0 Z17.05 F40
   G00 X0 Y0 Z25
   M5
   G91 G28 Z0
   G28 X0 Y0
   M30
   %
   ```

   That is a Fanuc mill program (tool change, G43 length offset, the electrode tip posted as the Z target, no condition or servo words) addressed to an EDM control. It is exactly the "wrong posted output" the Prime Directive forbids, and it contradicts the PR's own claim. The test `sinker_burn_held::the_post_admits_a_burn_on_its_sinker` only checks `op_streams`, not the written file. Fix: refuse by name, at the post door (`post_script_body`, and the per-mount and per-op writers that share it), any program whose machine is a wire or sinker EDM until #533 / #542 ship a dialect. A message like "no post for a sinker EDM yet (#542)" would do. Pin it with a test that `post_setup` (and the MCP post tool) refuses a Sinker Burn.

3. **The plunge can feed upward when the condition's gap is large (this is the dependency on #560).** `check()` in `crates/motion/src/sinker.rs:93-156` bounds the gap only from below (`gap < 0`). The tip is placed at `burn_floor + gap` (`:147`, `:169`) and is never compared with the approach plane. Until #560 bounds the gap, a condition with a large gap is accepted. A local probe with `gap: 30` (no wire, which #560 currently accepts) generated `G0 Z25 -> G1 Z47 F40 -> G0 Z25`: the "burn" feeds upward, above the approach plane. Verify then reported a 25 mm gouge over the whole block, because the box atom grows by the gap, so this case did block the post. That is luck of the fixture rather than a law: verify only catches it where the model is close around the electrode. Fix (one guard in `check()`): refuse by name when `tip >= approach_z` ("the spark gap X places the tip at or above the approach plane"). Consider also refusing a gap that is not smaller than the burn below the work top. With that guard, nothing in this PR relies on #560's unbounded values. The unbounded wire diameter is never read here, because the condition is asked for `Gap` only.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `SinkerParams::model_floor_z` is documented as "the model's floor under the electrode", but `sinker_op.rs:98-101` takes the lowest Z over all facets of the material, which is the global bottom. The guard is weaker than the doc says; either read the floor under the face footprint or reword the doc.
- An unknown or empty condition is refused when the op is generated, not when it is created (`sinker_burn.rs` `a_sinker_burn_needs_a_sinker_and_a_stated_condition`). That is defensible because the condition lives on the machine, but AGENTS.md prefers refusal at creation; consider calling `condition_gap` in `CreateOperation` / `EditOperationParams` for a SinkerBurn.
- `electrode_tool` draws the stem as a cylinder of the face's X size (`shank_d: x`). When the electrode's Y size is larger than X, any spun-body law (tool body / holder clearance) under-reads the electrode. The sim uses the box atom, so verify is not affected.
- The electrode's pickup offset (`shank_len`) is not used yet. That is expected with no post, but #542 will need it.
- Files already over ~400 lines grew a little: `operation/kinds.rs` (2505 -> 2542), `operation/generate.rs` (+12), `egui_app/pages.rs` (+14), `tools/tools.rs` (714 -> 739), `stock_sim.rs` (423 -> 445).

### Not exercised
- The UI suites (the crate does not compile).
- The heavy `--ignored` lanes.
- Any real EDM control.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
